about.title: About the model
about.p1: FarmSignal estimates remaining shelf life from temperature history using a Q10 degree-hour model per crop (tomato, guava). It always shows a range — pessimistic to optimistic — because the published parameters are themselves uncertain. The middle value is the most likely, not a promise.
about.p2: Every reading tightens the estimate. With no readings the app assumes the yard temperature from the protocol and says so (confidence: low).
about.p3: Mandi recommendations rank markets by expected value: price × (1 − spoilage on arrival) − transport cost, constrained by remaining shelf life. The "Why?" screen shows every input.
about.p4: Simulated readings and demo data are always labelled SIMULATED. Prices come from Agmarknet with a fetch time; stale or bundled prices are marked.
